name: Initramfs CI hook and test packages
what: postmarketos-mkinitfs-hook-ci runs tests inside the initramfs; tests ship as small subpackages that install themselves for the right device (postmarketos-test-suspend, -unl0kr).
for_us: Our automatic checks and the test kernel's timeout hook belong in this shape, so they can go upstream and run in their CI.

name: bootrr
what: Checks that every expected driver probed on a booted device; packaged in pmaports for the CI hook.
for_us: Replaces our hand-made waiting-to-probe checks with the established tool.

name: Device packages and deviceinfo
what: Each device package carries a deviceinfo file - codename, name, architecture, flash method, device tree - the device's manifest.
for_us: Our device.toml derives from deviceinfo and adds only what it lacks (how the lab reaches the phone), rather than duplicating it.

name: CI-tron
what: A bare-metal testing gateway: deploys test environments to devices, sequences power and boot, collects logs; devices are trained through boot cycles before they take jobs.
for_us: The gateway our lab machine could become, instead of growing its own.

name: mobian-recipes
what: Debian images built with debos; devices grouped in families by SoC; device packages (<device>-tweaks); weekly CI image builds. Points to the postmarketOS wiki to judge whether a device runs mainline.
for_us: Consumes mainline device support rather than building it: surya reaches Mobian through mainline and a family recipe, after pmOS.

name: postmarketOS hardware CI
what: Tests on real phones: CI-tron as the testing gateway, power units that switch devices and press buttons, GitLab pipelines generated per device from a template in its package; scaling toward a farm of dozens of devices (talk at the 2026 conference).
for_us: Our lab is a one-phone version of it. Aim: surya as a device under test in their farm, our tests in their shape - contributed, not kept apart.
